Name: Spartan
Weaponry: Wide array of heavy weaponry, shielding, and primary armor choices.
Physical: High starting Hit Points; fully focuses on martial development.
Primary Features & Mechanics: High Hit Points; specializes in a wide array of weaponry.

Name: Archanist
Weaponry: Restricted to lightweight tools, staves, and slings.
Academia: Archanist Spellbook from Level 1; spells learned faster than matching classes.
Primary Features & Mechanics: Learns spells faster than any other class; poor HP and heavy gear restrictions.

Name: Soulwright
Weaponry: Constrained to blunt weapons (maces, flails, and staves); consecrated weaponry.
Physical: Fairly robust health configuration; maximum speed scaling for divine protection.
Academia: Soulwright Spellbook from Level 1; rapid Soulwright spell learning.
Primary Features & Mechanics: Deep healing capabilities; rapid Soulwright spell learning; uses consecrated weaponry.

Name: Shade
Weaponry: Light stealth weapons and thieving/lockpicking tools.
Physical: High stealth, evasion mechanics, and double daArchanist surprise execution attacks.
Academia: None (No magic access); focuses on seamless trap diagnosis and disarming.
Primary Features & Mechanics: Circumvents treasure traps; picks locks and pockets; double daArchanist from shadows.

Name: Warden
Weaponry: Specialized ranged bows (receives highly accurate daArchanist bonuses).
Physical: High base health pool; specialized scouting and environment hazard identification.
Academia: Maester Spellbook unlocked automatically at Experience Level 3.
Primary Features & Mechanics: Specialized scouting for traps/secret walls; excellent accuracy/archery aim.

Name: Maester
Weaponry: Standard alchemical tools; handles formula-bound reagents.
Physical: Cannot be silenced in combat due to natural vocal-free text-casting rules.
Academia: Maester Spellbook from Level 1; faster casting progression, potion brewing, and structural manipulation.
Primary Features & Mechanics: Mixes potions; casts spells fastest; cannot be silenced due to natural text-casting rules.

Name: Echo
Weaponry: Unique enchanted instruments found in dungeons to evoke item-bound magic.
Physical: High communication, conversational, and oratory/voice skills.
Academia: Archanist Spellbook unlocked automatically at Experience Level 3.
Primary Features & Mechanics: Unique instrument usage to evoke item-bound magic; voice/oratory skills.

Name: Psynic
Weaponry: Restricted to basic defensive weapons like staves or slings.
Physical: Mind-disruption focus; balanced frontline gates (STR 10 / VIT 14).
Academia: Psynic Spellbook from Level 1; rapid learning of mind-altering and clari-sentient incantations.
Primary Features & Mechanics: Masters direct mental intrusion and alteration; clairvoyants and divinators.

Name: Amazon
Weaponry: Continuous reach and pole weapons (lances, spears).
Physical: Tremendous attack accuracy and daArchanist; character selection is restricted exclusively to female heroes.
Academia: Soulwright Spellbook unlocked automatically at Experience Level 3.
Primary Features & Mechanics: Restricted to female characters; specialized lance/pole weapon combatant.

Name: Wizard
Weaponry: Multi-caster utility staves and lighter robes.
Physical: Low physical baseline to compensate for massive magical versatility.
Academia: Dual-wields both Soulwright and Archanist Spellbooks from Level 1; individual tiers are learned significantly slower.
Primary Features & Mechanics: Dual spellcaster utilizing both major spell frameworks; significantly slower progression curve.

Name: Crusader
Weaponry: Equipped with top-tier heavy vanguard armors, weapons, and shielding.
Physical: Elite heavy vanguard fighter; highly durable with passive front-row secondary healing support.
Academia: Soulwright Spellbook unlocked automatically at Experience Level 3.
Primary Features & Mechanics: Elite heavy vanguard combatant; serves as a strong secondary passive support healer.

Name: Ronin
Weaponry: Specialized samurai blades and mid-to-heavy martial armor.
Physical: Exceptional attack velocity, high hit accuracy, and the innate Kirijutsu instant-kill execute passive.
Academia: Archanist Spellbook unlocked automatically at Experience Level 3.
Primary Features & Mechanics: Exceptional attack velocity; innate ability to instantly sever/critically execute foes.

Name: Voidhand
Weaponry: Extreme proficiency with unarmed / hand-and-foot combat systems.
Physical: Intense physical evasion and defensive body tuning to offset lighter protective garments.
Academia: Psynic Spellbook unlocked automatically at Experience Level 3.
Primary Features & Mechanics: Exceptional unarmed strike proficiency; enhanced physical evasion and critical blows.

Name: Ghostblade
Weaponry: Masters specialized ninja weaponry as well as raw fist-and-foot mechanics.
Physical: Master assassin combining stealth attacks, high baseline critical strike rates, and Shade thieving skills.
Academia: Maester Spellbook unlocked very late in professional character growth.
Primary Features & Mechanics: Master assassin combining hand-and-feet combat, critical kills, and stealth attacks.
